title: Cosmic Dreamer
description: A surreal profile of a woman with closed eyes, her head and hair dissolving into a vibrant cosmic nebula filled with glowing orbs and white smoke-like tendrils. Golden drips and waveforms flow from her silhouette into cracked earth below, where colorful petals and circular patterns emerge from the ground.
prompt: Surreal profile portrait of a woman facing right with closed eyes, her hair and upper body transforming into a vibrant cosmic nebula with glowing pink, purple, teal and yellow orbs against a black background. White smoke tendrils rise from her head, golden liquid drips from her neck and hand, soundwave patterns across the middle, her lower body merging into cracked earth with colorful flower petals and golden circular patterns blooming from the ground.
